QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_40

question.text: Ms. Sonia Rao, Fund Controller at Vindhya Capital (Cat I), is preparing the 180-day annual LP report. Which of the following is NOT among the material risks Category I and II AIFs must disclose in their annual report?

answer.text: Foreign exchange risk at fund level.
Daily NAV striking mechanism and series-of-units accounting methodology at fund level.
Extra-financial (ESG) risks at fund and investee-company level.

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.283 lists the Cat I/II annual-report material risks: concentration, foreign exchange, leverage, realisation, strategy, reputation, and extra-financial/ESG risks. Daily NAV striking and series-of-units accounting methodology are not on that list, so option C is the keyed NOT-among answer. The Trap: The daily-NAV option (C) describes an accounting mechanic that is not among the Cat I/II annual-report risk disclosures, which is exactly why it is the correct 'NOT among' choice. Options A, B and D are all on the source list. Note: Per workbook p.283, the Cat I/II annual-report material-risk list is concentration, foreign exchange, leverage, realisation, strategy, reputation, and extra-financial/ESG. NAV mechanics are accounting policy, not a risk disclosure.
